title: Accessibility assistance
content: Accessibility requests are free. Confirm the booking details and required accommodation. Escalate urgent unmet needs for travel within 48 hours.

title: Refund timelines
content: Approved card refunds normally appear within 5-10 business days. Duplicate charges and refunds overdue by more than 10 business days require escalation.

title: Booking changes
content: Most bookings can be changed up to 24 hours before departure. Same-day changes require an operations specialist.

title: Service disruptions
content: For active disruptions, verify the booking and escalate high-impact cases such as stranded passengers or missed critical connections.

title: Baggage information
content: Each passenger may bring one suitcase and one small personal item. Oversized items must be arranged in advance.
